description: This file contains declarations for functions related to signal data handling in AUTOSAR communication, including copying signal data between PDU buffers and shadow buffers, reading and writing signal data, and utilities for bit offset conversions.

methods.name: Com_CopySignalGroupDataFromPduToShadowBuffer
methods.description: Copies signal group data from the PDU to a shadow buffer based on the provided signal group ID.

methods.name: Com_CopySignalGroupDataFromShadowBufferToPdu
methods.description: Copies signal group data from the shadow buffer back into the PDU based on the signal group ID.

methods.name: Com_ReadSignalDataFromPduBuffer
methods.description: Reads specific signal data from a PDU buffer, supporting both group and individual signals.

methods.name: Com_WriteSignalDataToPdu
methods.description: Writes signal data to a PDU identified by its signal ID.

methods.name: Com_WriteSignalDataToPduBuffer
methods.description: Writes signal data directly into a PDU buffer, considering whether it's part of a group signal.

methods.name: motorolaBitNrToPduOffset
methods.description: Converts Motorola bit numbering to PDU offset.

methods.name: intelBitNrToPduOffset
methods.description: Converts Intel bit numbering to PDU offset, given segment length and total PDU length.

methods.name: Com_RxProcessSignals
methods.description: Processes received signals from a specified IPDU and its corresponding internal representation.

methods.name: getPduId
methods.description: Retrieves the PDU ID associated with a given IPDU.

methods.name: isPduBufferLocked
methods.description: Checks whether the specified PDU buffer is currently locked.

methods.name: UnlockTpBuffer
methods.description: Unlocks the transport protocol buffer for the given PDU ID.
